articles.title: Uber, Latest Victim of Disruption Panic, Still Has Role in Robotaxis
articles.mainIdea: Uber, Latest Victim of Disruption Panic, Still Has Role in Robotaxis
articles.summary: The Wall Street Journal: Uber, Latest Victim of Disruption Panic, Still Has Role in Robotaxis. Uber can’t seem to emerge from the shadow of what’s to come. Robotaxis are barely off the ground, but many investors already see the market as a two-horse race—with Uber not among them. Waymo is offering full commercial service in six U.S. cities, with a dozen more slated to come online over the next year or so. Related tickers mentioned: GOOG, LYFT, TSLA, UBER.

articles.title: Uber bets big on EV charging for both its drivers and future robotaxis
articles.mainIdea: Uber bets big on EV charging for both its drivers and future robotaxis
articles.summary: Yahoo Finance: Uber bets big on EV charging for both its drivers and future robotaxis. Uber announced a new push into EV charging on Wednesday with a two-pronged approach to serve both its current drivers on the platform today and autonomous robotaxis in the future. Related tickers mentioned: AMZN, GOOG, NURO.PVT, TSLA, UBER.
